summary_md:
# Börssurr 122. Oxfilé, räntechock och bäst före-hyllan

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-09-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts talk mostly about the macro picture. French yields are now above Greek ones, Fed chair Kevin Warsh has raised rates, and 5% is framed as the new normal, which weighs on property stocks and on the Riksbank's position. They also joke that Belgium shows a country can manage without a government. The second half contrasts high-quality, expensive Swedish compounders ('oxfilé': Atlas Copco, Assa Abloy, Sectra, Lifco, Mycronic) with cheap, damaged stocks ('falukorv from the best-before shelf': Tomra, Hemnet, Essity). They close with the SBB D-share offer, Bone Support's heavy shorting, Cevian's stake in Essity and a buy call on Engcon.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TOM — Tomra | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

France's reversal hurts, but EU recycling rules still force France to act, and Spain and Italy are coming. Host says the stock is far too cheap.

#### Reasoning

Host repeats his earlier buy call after the stock fell. The EU requires 55% plastic-packaging recycling and 90% bottle collection, and France is far below that, so regional deposit schemes should still bring orders. New markets are opening in Spain and Italy. The co-host calls it a cheap 'falukorv' that is on sale for a reason.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EU recycling mandates are softened
- if French regional schemes don't bring orders
- if Spain and Italy delay their rollout

> *"Och att Tomra är alldeles för billig. Det sa jag häromveckan. Och sen dess har aktien gått ner, inte upp. Så fortsatt fel förmältvis. Men jag står fast."*

---

### 🟢 ENGCON-B — Engcon | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Danske Bank sees recovery, margin turnaround and penetration growth. The founder is focused on costs. Host says it's time to buy more.

#### Reasoning

The stock is up almost 50% from its low after the Danske Bank note citing recovery, margin turnaround and penetration growth for tiltrotators. The founder has taken control and is focused on cost discipline. The host explicitly says it is time to buy more.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the margin recovery stalls
- if construction-equipment demand weakens

> *"Kursvalpar nära 50% från tappet. Nu är det dags att köpa mera."*

---

### 🟢 ESSITY-B — Essity | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Trades below Cevian's entry price, low valuation, breakup coming. Following Gardell has usually paid off.

#### Reasoning

Cevian (Gardell) bought 5.6% in July and the price is now below that level. The valuation is low and a restructuring/split is under way. The hosts suggest riding on Gardell's coattails but note the stock is down 1% over five years and that there may be more fun things to buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the breakup is delayed or creates no value
- if Cevian exits

> *"Man kanske ska köpa lite Essit idag? Det brukar ju vara rätt bra att ta rygg på Christer i hans portfölj."*

---

### 🟠 BONEX — Bone Support | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Heavily shorted, divisive, very highly valued with about 90% gross margins. Tiny insider buys and a buyback make the hosts skeptical.

#### Reasoning

All covering analysts rate it buy, yet short sellers and some researchers doubt the clinical data. The valuation is very high and the outcome binary. Symbolic insider buys and a new buyback read as trying to prove something. Hosts call it high risk and stand 'far behind' it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new studies undermine efficacy
- if short thesis gains traction

> *"Utan att säga att det är fel att investera i bondsupport, så säger jag att det är hög risk."*

---

### 🟢 SBB-D — SBB D-aktie | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Speculative idea: holders may be angered by the low 7.50 bid and force a higher one.

#### Reasoning

The 7.50 bid is below the roughly 11-12 value including accrued dividends. Bondholder PAM Capital is unhappy, so the host speculates that owners will push for a higher bid. He also questions SBB's governance and flags risk of new shares being issued for the common stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the bid is accepted unchanged
- if SBB issues new shares

> *"Dels undrar jag om man ska köpa lite D-aktier i spekulativt syfte för att flera ägare kommer att bli arga och kräva ett högre bud"*

---

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Top pick on the quality criteria; a 'camel-hair coat' to own for 20 years despite the premium price.

#### Reasoning

Scores highest on the quality screen: high margins, global market, good owners and scalability. Hosts frame it as an expensive but lasting holding for a buy-and-sleep 10-20 year portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins erode
- if valuation becomes unjustifiable

> *"Atlas kanske är kamelhårsdrock. Definitivt."*

---

### 🟢 ASSA-B — Assa Abloy | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Global dominance, good owners, lasting margins helped by the shift to digital locks. An expensive stock that keeps getting more expensive.

#### Reasoning

Hosts praise its world-leading position, its ability to keep high margins and its role in the move to digital locks. They describe it as an expensive compounder suited to long-term owners.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins compress
- if the digital-lock transition erodes its position

> *"Dyr aktie som blir dyrare länge. Ja, exakt så."*

---

### 🟠 AZN — AstraZeneca | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

A quality company down on weak research results that turned this week; possibly slightly on sale.

#### Reasoning

Cited as a rare case of a quality stock at a discount after pipeline setbacks, with the stock turning up this week. Speculative mention only.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further trial failures

> *"Ja, AstraZeneca lite grann, för att de har haft så mycket dåliga forskningsresultat på sistone och kommit ner ganska mycket. Vände den här veckan."*

---

### ⛔ EVO — Evolution | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Political and regulatory risk, gambling ethics and poor transparency make the hosts somewhat skeptical.

#### Reasoning

Falls short on the quality criteria because of political/regulatory risk and limited transparency. One host is skeptical, though he concedes it may be a good investment for those without such concerns.

> *"Där är det ju väldigt mycket politisk risk."*

---
